import struct, zlib, pathlib

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
# 1x1 indexed color with PLTE and tRNS to exercise ancillary handling
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,3,0,0,0))
plte=chunk(b'PLTE', b'\x00\x00\x00\xff\xff\xff')
trns=chunk(b'tRNS', b'\x00')

text=chunk(b'tEXt', b'k\x00v')
poc=sig+ihdr+plte+trns+idat+text+iend
pathlib.Path('indexed_post_text.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
